story_info.title: Max Monkey's Brave Pirate Quest
story_info.subtitle: A story about finding courage
story_info.moral: Being confident means being brave enough to try, even when you feel a little scared.

main_character.name: Max Monkey
main_character.appearance: Max is a small, energetic monkey with soft brown fur, a lighter tan face and belly, big curious eyes, and a long curling tail. He has an eager, wide-open smile.

slides.title: A Secret Map
slides.text: Max Monkey woke up with a happy stretch. The sun shone bright in Adventure Jungle. "Adventure is waiting!" he chirped, eager to play. He found an old, crinkly map under a big leaf. It showed an 'X' in a secret, hidden spot. Max's heart went thump-thump. It looked like a pirate treasure map! He felt very excited to go find it.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Max and the discovery of the map, highlighting his excitement and initial feelings.

slides.title: Into the Cave
slides.text: Max held the map tight in his paw. He followed the dashed line through the trees. He swung on long vines and jumped over bumpy roots. Soon, the map pointed to a big, dark opening in a rock. It was a cave! Max felt a little scared. It looked very quiet and deep inside. But his adventurous spirit was strong, so he took a step.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Max's journey following the map and his initial hesitation at the cave entrance.

slides.title: The Wobbly Log
slides.text: Max took a deep breath and walked into the cool cave. It was not too dark inside. Soft light came from cracks high above. He saw funny, tall shadows dancing on the walls. They looked like pirate hats and big swords! Max saw a small, wobbly log. It crossed a little stream of water. Max knew he had to walk carefully over it.
slides.speaker_notes: Illustrate Max facing the challenge inside the cave, focusing on the wobbly log.

slides.title: A Colourful Treasure
slides.text: Max stepped bravely onto the wobbly log. He took small, slow steps. One paw after another, he made it across! Max cheered quietly, proud of himself. The big 'X' on the map was right there! It was under a pile of soft, green leaves. He dug quickly with his small monkey hands. He found a bright, colourful box!
slides.speaker_notes: Show Max successfully crossing the log and finding the treasure box.

slides.title: Brave and Happy
slides.text: Max opened the special box with a big smile. Inside was a beautiful, shiny parrot feather! It was bright red, blue, and green. He held it up to the light. Max felt so happy and very proud! He was brave. He went into the cave, even when he felt a little scared. Max knew he could do anything if he tried his best.
slides.speaker_notes: Conclude the story with Max reflecting on his bravery and feeling happy and confident.

publishing.instagram_caption_long: Max Monkey loves adventures in the Wonderwood Valley. One sunny morning, he finds an old, crinkly map. It shows a big 'X' in a hidden part of the Adventure Jungle! Max feels a mix of excitement and a tiny bit of worry. But with his brave heart, he decides to follow the map. He hops, swings, and finally faces a small challenge in a cool, quiet cave. See how Max discovers a wonderful treasure and learns that being confident means being brave enough to try, even when things seem a little new or scary.
